text:
sana: Heads-up — bringing up Stargaze's LoRA (v1.2) against llama-13b-int4 on staging. Quick evalpack shows weird invoice line-item truncation and currency token drift. attaching evalpack results shortly
matt: ack. can you paste the prompt set you used?
sana: promptset: invoice-v2 (line_items + totals). quick command: `rwd-eval run --pack invoice-v2 --model llama-13b-int4 --adapter stargaze-lora-v1.2 --out /tmp/stargaze-eval.json`
eva: saw the diff: totals sometimes missing cents and amounts get rounded oddly. looks quant-related. do we have tokenizer mismatch?
matt: ran tokenizer check: `python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; print(Tokenizer.from_file('llama-tokenizer.json').encode('€ 12.50'))"` — tokens match upstream.
oliver: infra-bot kicked a smoke build: staging node 3 returned OOM on a 512 context run, but the evalpack mostly completed on node 1. infra-bot: smoke-test failed on node-3: OOM at step 42 (alloc 7.4GB)
sana: thanks. this customer uses decimal-prefixed amounts like EUR:12.50 and also inline linebreak separators. suspect LoRA interacts with KV caching when quantized.
matt: attached sample outputs (short). original finetune baseline (fp16 + no adapter) vs int4+adapter:
```
BASELINE: Line items:
- 1x Widget A — €12.50
- 3x Widget B — €37.50
TOTAL: €50.00

INT4+STARGAZE: Line items:
- 1x Widget A — 12
- 3x Widget B — 37
TOTAL: 49
```
eva: wow dropped cents and euro symbol. could be a learned embedding offset for currency symbol token indices after quantization.
oliver: can we repro with 4bit qlora vs int4 post-compile? also try disabling kv-cache to see if it's caching prefix wrong.
sana: plan: 1) run `rwd-serve --model llama-13b --quant int4 --adapter stargaze-lora-v1.2 --kv-cache=false` 2) run quick evalpack with `--seed 42` and `--fewshots 0` 3) generate token logits for the currency token indices and diff against baseline
matt: running step1 now on a small host, will paste logs.
infra-bot: deploy started: host stg-small-7 (id s7) image rwd-runtime:2026-03-22
matt: log snippet: `INFO model: loaded adapter stargaze-lora-v1.2; quant_mode=int4; kv_cache=disabled`
matt: quick eval results: cents preserved when kv_cache=false. with kv_cache=true cents dropped ~28% of examples.
eva: confirms suspicion — kv-cache interaction. maybe adapter writes to early KV layers and quantized rounding amplifies token id collisions.
sana: could try adapter-scale trick: apply multiplier 0.7 to LoRA deltas on serving and re-eval. also try per-channel quant rescale (we have a patch branch).
matt: tried adapter-scale 0.7 — cents drop reduced but still ~5% failures. attaching diff.
oliver: open question for model infra: is our kernel selecting the same embedding table layout for int4 w/adapter? if layout differs between nodes it could explain node-3 OOM and divergence. filing ENG-RUNTIME ticket.
sana: filed: ENG-RT-4123 (link) — runtime to check embedding layout + kv offsets with adapter overlays.
eva: for customer-facing next steps: 1) run a small canary with kv_cache disabled (fast workaround) 2) propose patch to adapter (rescale + token remap) 3) offer to run a deterministic eval sweep with 500 invoice prompts and attach CSV of mismatches
matt: I'll export the eval CSV: `/artifacts/stargaze/1839990001/eval-500.csv` — includes input, baseline, patched, adapter-scale=0.7 rows.
infra-bot: artifact uploaded: /artifacts/stargaze/1839990001/eval-500.csv (size 1.1MB)
sana: assigning tasks — matt: run the canary with kv_cache=false on dedicated nodes and confirm perf impact; eva: try small adapter patch (scale + token remap) and test; oliver: follow ENG-RT-4123 and triage OOM
matt: can do, starting canary now. ETA ~2h
eva: I'll open a tiny evalpack PR with patch and tests. tag me for review.
oliver: will check kernel selector logs and memory footprint; ping if you see node variance.
sana: thanks team. we'll keep customer updated: recommend temporary kv_cache disable and schedule a deeper rollout once runtime fix and adapter patch validated. :thumbsup:
matt: canary complete — perf drop ~3% p50 latency, kv_cache off; cents preserved.
eva: PR up: stargaze/adapter-fix branch. includes unit test and promptcase reproducer.
infra-bot: note: canary on node s7 completed successfully at 1839990123
